HYPERDRIVE.description: Select an existing Hyperdrive connection to your PostgreSQL 17 database with pgvector. Query caching must already be disabled. See the README setup steps.

ORIGINALS.description: Private originals bucket. Configure exact-origin PUT CORS, and set R2_BUCKET_NAME to this same bucket name.

JOBS.description: Queue for durable media and inference jobs.

AI.description: Workers AI runs Cloudflare-hosted Nova-3 transcription. Provider allowance and actual media limits still apply.

APP_ORIGIN.description: Public HTTPS origin for this Worker, such as your chosen workers.dev hostname. No path, query or fragment.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID, containing the selected Hyperdrive, originals bucket, Stream and Worker.

R2_BUCKET_NAME.description: Enter exactly the bucket name selected for ORIGINALS.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate once with openssl rand -base64 48. Keep stable across deployments.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access Key ID from an R2 Object Read and Write token scoped to the originals bucket.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret Access Key for that same scoped R2 token.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Narrow runtime token for Stream Edit and Workers AI Read and Edit. Do not paste the operator or build deployment token here.
